scripts.install-all: npm install && npm --prefix services/core install && npm --prefix services/forex install && npm --prefix services/notification install && npm --prefix web-v2 install
scripts.start: concurrently "npm --prefix services/core run dev" "npm --prefix services/forex start" "npm --prefix web-v2 run dev" --names "core,forex,web" --prefix "[{time}] {name}:"
scripts.start:docker-daemon: docker-compose up -d && echo 'Services running in background. Use docker-compose logs -f to view logs.'
scripts.test: npm --prefix services/core run test && npm --prefix web-v2 run test
